name: Tally
description: Live channels from your own M3U, XMLTV, HLS and web page sources, with a guide; live scores matched to the channels showing each game; a live TV page in Jellyfin's web client; and the install page for the Tally TV app.
overview: Live TV and live sports for Jellyfin and the Tally app
